scope: Corollary 1.2 (Individual Kähler realizations) of the manuscript “Deforming hypersymplectic four-manifolds to hyperkähler triples” (preprints/Deforming-hypersymplectic-four-manifolds-to-hyperkahler-triples-October-7-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 341 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 92c36602fb496808), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 1-2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let X be a closed connected oriented smooth four-manifold with a smooth positive triple ω of closed real two-forms. For every fixed c ∈ R3 \ {0}, the form αc = ∑︁ i ciωi is a Kähler form for a parallel integrable complex structure Jc of some hyperkähler metric gc on X: αc(v, w) = gc(Jcv, w). Date: October 7, 2026. 1 2 OPENAI The compatible structure is chosen separately for each c; no simultaneous transport of the triple is asserted.
